Prospective drug review, and retrospective DUR, are not required for drugs dispensed to residents of nursing facilities that comply with the drug regimen review procedures in 42 CFR part 483; a state agency may still elect to make such drugs subject to DUR if it applies all subpart requirements. [42-CFR-456.703(b)]

Retrospective DUR uses predetermined standards to monitor the same problem types, cross-referencing 456.705(b) items on duplication, drug-disease contraindication, drug-drug interaction, dosage, duration, and clinical abuse or misuse, plus therapeutic appropriateness, over/underutilization, and generic use.
